game.title: Crystal Caverns

plan.title: Crystal Caverns
plan.concept: A glowing underground platform adventure where the player leaps across fragile crystal formations, gathers gem clusters, and navigates hazardous caverns to reach each exit portal. The journey gets more challenging as platform layouts become tighter, with checkpoints tied to gem collection to keep the adventure moving.
plan.gameplay_summary: Players run and jump through underground caverns, chaining precise platforming moves to cross gaps, collect gems, and avoid crystal spikes. Each cavern ends at a portal exit, with later stages introducing tighter jumps and more demanding platform patterns.
plan.visual_style_summary: Ice-blue crystal caves with glowing highlights, sparkling reflections, and a cool subterranean atmosphere. The scene should feel magical but dangerous, with sharp crystalline shapes and luminous gem accents.
plan.player_appearance: cave explorer in a glowing crystal suit
plan.subject: platform adventure
plan.learning_objective: Build timing, spatial reasoning, and pattern recognition through precision platforming challenges.
plan.controls: arrow keys or A/D to move, space to jump, click/tap for mobile controls
plan.replayability: Players can replay caverns to collect more gems, improve completion time, and master harder jump routes.

visual_plan.visual_style_summary: Ice-blue crystal caves with glowing highlights, sparkling reflections, and a cool subterranean atmosphere. The scene should feel magical but dangerous, with sharp crystalline shapes and luminous gem accents.
visual_plan.player_appearance: cave explorer in a glowing crystal suit

game.request: Crystal Caverns — a platform adventure deep underground. Jump across glowing crystal platforms, collect gem clusters, avoid crystal spikes, reach the exit portal of each cavern. Checkpoints at collected gems, ice-blue crystalline atmosphere, increasingly tricky platform layouts across caverns.

spec.title: Crystal Caverns
spec.description: Leap through nine glowing underground caverns, chain gem pickups for combo multipliers, dodge crystal spikes, and race to the exit portal in this ice-blue spelunking adventure.
spec.subject: Platform Adventure / Spatial Reasoning
spec.learning_objective: Develop jump timing, spatial awareness, and sequential problem-solving by navigating increasingly complex crystal platform layouts across nine distinct caverns.
spec.controls: Arrow Keys or WASD to move; Space / W / Up Arrow to jump; double-tap Jump for double-jump (unlocked Stage 3+). Mobile: on-screen D-pad for left/right, large Jump button; touch gems to activate checkpoints.

visual_theme.player_name: Crystal Runner — a nimble spelunker with an ice-blue glowing headlamp and frosted gear

achievements.label: Flawless Spelunker — Complete a stage without taking damage
Gem Hoarder — Collect all gems in a single stage
Speed Runner — Complete any stage in under 30 seconds
Combo Master — Reach a x5 gem combo in one stage
Deep Diver — Reach Stage 5
Cavern Conqueror — Complete all 9 caverns
Immortal — Finish the entire game without losing a life
Checkpoint Chain — Activate 4 checkpoints in one stage
High Scorer — Beat your personal best total score
